email_delivery_attempts_snapshot_lengths.name: email_delivery_attempts_snapshot_lengths_check
email_delivery_attempts_snapshot_lengths.value: length("email_delivery_attempts"."subject_snapshot") between 1 and 200 and length("email_delivery_attempts"."provider") between 1 and 40 and length("email_delivery_attempts"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 100

email_delivery_attempts_terminal_timesta.name: email_delivery_attempts_terminal_timestamp_check
email_delivery_attempts_terminal_timesta.value: ("email_delivery_attempts"."status" not in ('SENT', 'DELIVERED') or "email_delivery_attempts"."sent_at" is not null) and ("email_delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'DELIVERED' or "email_delivery_attempts"."delivered_at" is not null) and ("email_delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'FAILED' or "email_delivery_attempts"."failed_at" is not null)

events_coordinates_pair_check.name: events_coordinates_pair_check
events_coordinates_pair_check.value: ("events"."latitude" is null and "events"."longitude" is null) or ("events"."latitude" is not null and "events"."longitude" is not null)

guests_invitation_count_consistency.name: guests_invitation_count_consistency
guests_invitation_count_consistency.value:
("guests"."invitation_count_mode" = 'TOTAL_ONLY' and "guests"."total_invited" >= 0 and "guests"."adults_invited" is null and "guests"."children_invited" is null) or
          ("guests"."invitation_count_mode" = 'ADULTS_AND_CHILDREN' and "guests"."adults_invited" is not null and "guests"."adults_invited" >= 0 and "guests"."children_invited" is not null and "guests"."children_invited" >= 0 and "guests"."total_invited" = "guests"."adults_invited" + "guests"."children_invited")

guests_preferred_channel_contact_check.name: guests_preferred_channel_contact_check
guests_preferred_channel_contact_check.value:
("guests"."preferred_channel" = 'EMAIL' and "guests"."email" is not null) or
          ("guests"."preferred_channel" = 'SMS' and "guests"."phone" is not null) or
          ("guests"."preferred_channel" = 'BOTH' and "guests"."email" is not null and "guests"."phone" is not null) or
          ("guests"."preferred_channel" = 'MANUAL' and "guests"."email" is null and "guests"."phone" is null)

invitations_revoked_state_check.name: invitations_revoked_state_check
invitations_revoked_state_check.value: ("invitations"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "invitations"."revoked_at" is not null) or ("invitations"."status" <> 'REVOKED' and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null)

rsvps_non_attending_counts_cleared_check.name: rsvps_non_attending_counts_cleared_check
rsvps_non_attending_counts_cleared_check.value: "rsvps"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' or ("rsvps"."total_attending" is null and "rsvps"."adults_attending" is null and "rsvps"."children_attending" is null)
